# Mahmood Sultan

> Portfolio of Mahmood Sultan — third-year CCIT & TCS student at the University of Toronto Mississauga, open to tech internships and co-ops.

Mahmood Sultan is a student developer and designer based in Toronto. This portfolio showcases selected case studies, background, and contact information.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Hero introduction to Mahmood Sultan.
- [About](/#about): Background, education, and experience.
- [Selected work](/#work): Case studies for My Code Club, Campus Navigation System (4-person team project), and Turtle Island Charity, plus shorter projects including the Calorie Tracking App and 100-Level Platformer Game.
- [Contact](/#contact): Get in touch with Mahmood.
